itemized.notes: AMELIA POWERS GARDNER, filed by the channel under candidacyYear 2021 / 'Special Election', modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20'. A BORN-DIGITAL TYPED fillable form, digitally signed ('Digitally signed by Amelia Powers Gardner, Date: 2022.04.02 17:02:21 -06'00''), printed and re-scanned on a Canon iR-ADV. *** THE 2021 FORM, CHARACTERISED (first 2021 filing of this chunk) *** SIX pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page', p5 the CHECKLIST DECOY, p6 BLANK. (1) The SUMMARY PAGE is p4 — the last page of the REPORT but NOT the last page of the PDF, because the checklist and a blank sheet follow it; located by content. (2) THE CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND IN AT p5: a sheet headed 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' with a Website/Network/HOLD box, reciting every summary-page label ('Balance at Beginning of Period', 'Contributions Received this Period', '... Year to Date', 'Expenditures Made this Period', '... Year to Date', 'Subtotal before Expenditures', 'Positive balance at Close of Reporting Period') and carrying ZERO dollar figures, printed TWICE on the one sheet with two staff review copies — 'Staff Signature #1' ticked in red and dated 4/4/22, 'Staff Signature #2' ticked in purple and dated 4/4/2022. It is a clerk work product, not a report page. (3) The schedules are the same FULLY BOXED 15-row grids as 2020, and SCHEDULE B HAS A REAL PURPOSE COLUMN (Date / Provider-Vendor / Purpose / Amount). (4) Each schedule prints TWO footers ('Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... Sum of all Schedule A/B pages in this report'), both filled here and equal. (5) THE COVER GAINED A REPORT TYPE the 2020 blank did not have — 'Seven days preceding Convention' — and the 2020 option '30 Days after the Primary Election' is GONE; five options in all. (6) TWO DIFFERENT BLANK VINTAGES ARE BOUND INTO ONE FILING: pp1 and 3 carry the 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' masthead in blue, pp2 and 4 the older 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' masthead — the addendum-F6 'cover and schedules stocked independently' property, now seen in the modern era and WITHIN a single filing. (7) Foliation is present and cover-counted (Page 1/2/3/4 on pp1-4; the checklist and the blank sheet are unfoliated). REPORT TYPE IS AN HONEST BLANK: not one of the five 'Mark the applicable report' radios is filled, and 'Is this report an amendment?' is answered neither Yes nor No — both left wholly unanswered by the filer, never read as 'No'. DATE / CYCLE CONFLICT, recorded and NOT adjudicated (election_year is an acquisition-layer decision above this wave): the channel files this under candidacyYear 2021 with reporting_period 'Special Election', while the page's own Date of Report boxes on pp1-4 all read 4/02/2022 and the Office box reads 'Utah County Commission Seat A'. Every transaction on both schedules is dated in 2021 (3/18/2021 through 12/6/2021). The page face is recorded as printed. Page-face candidate 'Amelia Powers Gardner' agrees with the channel label. PRIVACY: the county published this filing UNREDACTED — full street lines appear in every Schedule A address cell and on the cover — and every one was reduced to city/state at read time; no street line reached this record, not a field and not a note. Columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen): no inversion on either schedule. All six row-index traps screened: first written entry is band 1 on both pages (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, no entry below the last rule (both grids have empty bands after the last entry, crop-proved), and no doubled band. Both sides close to the cent.
